completionOps.text: Whatever is stalking Bent Pine has been named in writing now. Frostbitten knows what it is hunting.

completionOps.title: Story Sync: Watch Ridge Cleanup
completionOps.summary: Bent Pine becomes a known problem instead of a quiet one. Frostbitten has work and a name for it.

nodes.text: The gate office smells like wet rope and old tea. Captain Lysa has her notes already laid out in three columns: rumor, witness, paperwork. Bin's name appears in every column. Twice in two of them.

nodes.speaker: Captain Lysa
nodes.text: Talk me through Bent Pine the way you talked through it for Peri. Then talk me through it again the way you would talk to your father. I need both to write this down honestly.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: The route is alive. Whatever crosses the line is fast, picks fights up close, and resets when it loses contact. I will allow Bin to say one tasteless joke. I will not allow two.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: It hunts on a loop. We can clear the ridge once, the next pass it has moved one cell. It does not chase honor. It is patient about the wrong things. I would close Bent Pine until a real party walks it.

nodes.prompt: Frostbitten's official response to Bent Pine.

ops.text: Bent Pine is officially closed to civilian patrols.

choices.label: Run escorted patrols only
choices.summary: Compromise. Trickier later if losses occur.

ops.text: Bent Pine stays open, but only with armed escort.

nodes.speaker: Captain Lysa
nodes.text: Closed it is. We will post the warnings inside the hour and a writ goes out by tomorrow. If anyone wants to argue, they can argue with the boots that walked it.

nodes.speaker: Captain Lysa
nodes.text: Escort only. Two guards minimum, one bow at distance. I will not pretend that is safe, but I will pretend it is responsible enough for the gate ledger.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: Then we ask the apothecary about wound packs that hold for nine hours, and we ask the smith about a longer poker. Whatever the thing is, we are about to outlast it once on purpose.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: Sorry. I lost the thread halfway. Two months of not sleeping in normal beds caught up to me in this exact room. Please pretend that sounded brave when you write it down.

nodes.speaker: Garr
nodes.text: I will write it down brave. I will also write it down kindly. Welcome home. Now come back to the hut before your sister Lily decides you are a hallucination.

nodes.summary: Route A converges toward the Frostbitten town meeting.

ops.text: Frostbitten's official position on Bent Pine is filed. The town can now hold a real meeting.
